committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects Early Head Start teachers, staff working toward credentials, mentors, and children and families served in these classrooms.
dimensions.evidence: each additional teacher providing direct services to children and families... is working towards earning a credential

dimensions.assessment: Changes qualification rules from requiring all teachers to hold a CDA credential to requiring at least one teacher per classroom to hold it, while others work toward it with a mentor.
dimensions.evidence: at least one teacher per classroom who is... has a minimum of a child development associate credential

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending authorizations or economic appropriations are mentioned in the text.
Amends Section 645A(h) of the Head Start Act regarding staff credentialing and mentorship requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Head Start Act to permit some teachers in Early Head Start programs to teach while earning a child development associate credential.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to Head Start program qualification statutes.

missing_information: Number of Early Head Start teachers currently lacking credentials who would be affected
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies staff credential requirements for Early Head Start classrooms, allowing additional teachers to teach while working toward a Child Development Associate credential under mentor supervision.
